question: Based on the sur_refl_b04 and sur_refl_b06 data in Greenland in 2020 and 2024, calculate the NDSI of the region. First calculate the average NDSI for each date in 2020, and then calculate the average NDSI for each date in 2024. Then calculate the coefficient of variation(CV) of the NDSI fluctuation in 2020, and then calculate the coefficient of variation of the NDSI fluctuation in 2024. According to the difference in the coefficient of variation, determine the difference in the snow cover volatility in Greenland and give the difference.
